req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for subsequent DELETE calls on the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE operation should be idempotent, meaning that performing the operation multiple times should have the same effect as performing it once. The requirement specifies that subsequent DELETE requests on the same task_id should return a 404 status code, indicating that the task no longer exists. This behavior ensures that the system correctly handles repeated DELETE requests without causing errors or inconsistencies.

tests.name: test_delete_task_once
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_task_twice
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
expected: First DELETE request receives HTTP 204 No Content response
Second DELETE request receives HTTP 404 Not Found response
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response1 = client.delete('/tasks/1')
assert response1.status_code == 204

response2 = client.delete('/tasks/1')
assert response2.status_code == 404
assert response2.json() == {"detail": "Task with id 1 not found"}

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_task
preconditions: Task with id 21 does not exist in the database
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
